changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: UPDATE jobs SET pricing_version = '2026-09-v1', currency = 'TRY', worker_payout = ROUND(salary, 2), commission_rate = 0.0750, commission_amount = ROUND(ROUND(salary, 2) * 0.0750, 2), total_charged = ROUND(salary, 2) + ROUND(ROUND(salary, 2) * 0.0750, 2) WHERE salary IS NOT NULL

UPDATE job_assignments SET pricing_version = (SELECT jobs.pricing_version FROM jobs WHERE jobs.id = job_assignments.job_id), currency = (SELECT jobs.currency FROM jobs WHERE jobs.id = job_assignments.job_id), worker_payout = COALESCE(worker_payout, (SELECT jobs.worker_payout FROM jobs WHERE jobs.id = job_assignments.job_id)), commission_rate = COALESCE(commission_rate, (SELECT jobs.commission_rate FROM jobs WHERE jobs.id = job_assignments.job_id)), commission_amount = COALESCE(commission_amount, (SELECT jobs.commission_amount FROM jobs WHERE jobs.id = job_assignments.job_id)), total_charged = COALESCE(total_charged, (SELECT jobs.total_charged FROM jobs WHERE jobs.id = job_assignments.job_id))
UPDATE payments SET pricing_version = (SELECT job_assignments.pricing_version FROM job_assignments WHERE job_assignments.id = payments.job_assignment_id)
